description: This Java class 'DefaultDataUpdateService' implements data update and rule node upgrade functionalities for the Thingsboard platform, including methods for upgrading rule nodes, processing batches, and retrieving node IDs based on type and version.

classes.name: DefaultDataUpdateService
classes.description: Service class for updating data and upgrading rule nodes within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Logs the start and completion of data update process.

methods.name: upgradeRuleNodes
methods.description: Main method to upgrade rule nodes by type and version, processing in batches.

methods.name: processRuleNodePack
methods.description: Processes a batch of rule nodes, upgrading each and saving asynchronously.

methods.name: getRuleNodesIdsWithTypeAndVersionLessThan
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of rule nodes of a specific type with version less than the specified.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Reads environment variable and returns boolean default if not set.
